integrity: Analytic proof and independent numerical grounded-matrix tests embedded. Full research review passed; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification restricted to unit-edge stars, perfect pinned leaders, unit-isotropic follower forcing, and zero initial covariance. An equivalent uncatalogued finite-horizon theorem may exist. The stationary threshold is prior art, not newly claimed.
title: Two observation-horizon laws for perfectly grounded leaders on star networks
